tool.name: DtedDmed

param.name: folder
param.dialogReference: The delivery: the folder that holds the DTED folder of cells laid out as DTED/E006/N49.dt2, or that DTED folder itself. Masks, logs and DTED0 companion files in the tree are ignored; a cell whose name disagrees with its header, or cells of several levels, are reported.

param.name: dmed_file
param.dialogReference: Where to write the DMED. By default DMED at the root of the delivery, beside the DTED folder, as MIL-PRF-89020B 3.9 places it.

param.name: check_only
param.dialogReference: Do not write: compare the existing DMED with what the cells give and report the differences.

tool.summary: Writes the DMED volume file of MIL-PRF-89020B 3.9.5 for a DTED delivery laid out as DTED/E006/N49.dt2: a header record with the bounding rectangle of the cells, then one 394-byte record per cell of the rectangle, columns west to east and south to north within a column, holding the cell's edition and match/merge version and, for each of its 16 areas of 15 minutes, the minimum, maximum and mean elevation and the standard deviation of the posts in whole meters. A cell of the rectangle that is not in the delivery is its coordinates and blanks. Void posts are left out of the statistics and an area with no valid post is blank. The same file is written on the command line by "egmtrans dmed FOLDER" and checked by "egmtrans dmed FOLDER --check".
tool.usage: Run it on a finished delivery: every cell under DTED/ is read, so the DMED describes the delivery as it stands. Rerun it after cells are added or replaced.
